LogText.DefaultText: Guard Old Corrin thrusts his cudgel at you!

AlternateLogTexts.DefaultText: Old corrin jabs at you with the cudgel!
Old corrin swings the cudgel at your head!

LogText.DefaultText: You fail to get clear and the cudgel connects...
You get out of the way in time...
Fortunately, the attack wasn't enough to hurt you.
The spear grazed you, leaving a shallow cut.
The spear nicked your flesh.
You suffered a small puncture wound.
The spear drove into you, drawing blood.
The spear struck true and tore into your flesh.
You suffered a painful spear wound.
The spear pierced you with brutal force.
The spear sinks deep, leaving a terrible wound.
Old corrin presses forward with the cudgel, breathing hard!

AlternateLogTexts.DefaultText: Old corrin makes a tired swing with the cudgel.
Old corrin lunges clumsily with the cudgel.

Old Corrin shuffles into range, cudgel raised...
Old Corrin folds and does not get back up. You have killed a guard of the village Watch.
Old Corrin drops his guard, backs off with both hands up and keeps backing off. He is beaten, but he is not dead.
You break away from Old Corrin and run. It does not take much.
You have nothing left. Old Corrin pins you down and shouts for the Captain.

EventDescription.DefaultText: He is old, he is slow, and he did not ask for this beat. Striking him is a crime whether you win or not.
